Hi Karthik,

We're starting our compliance handback for the CardioAssist pilot and need Redwood to perform a full sanitation of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and associated service logs for the pilot tenancy (tenant-id: nova-cardio-2024). Scope: prod and staging, period Jan 1 2025 - Sep 30 2025.

Please share:
- Your end-to-end execution plan and expected timeline
- Types of evidence you'll produce (manifest, runbooks, signed attestation)
- Any items we need to sign or approve before execution

Target completion window: within 5 business days if possible.

Thanks — Claire

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear scope. Forwarding initial plan and timeline below; Laura (Security) and Marissa (Ops) are looped for sign-off and execution.

Summary plan (high level):
1) Scope confirmation: confirm tenant-id and buckets/paths to sweep (we have default locations but will validate).
2) Pre-check: snapshot (read-only) of indices and a short PII scan to confirm items in scope.
3) Execution window: we propose a rolling sanitation starting 2025-10-09 14:00 PT, targeting completion within 48 hours for the stated period across prod+staging.
4) Mechanism: KV-cache purge, prompt-output tombstoning + overwrite for S3 objects, and log truncation with rekeying for audit trails.
5) Evidence: evidence_manifest_20251009.json (job ids, object counts), sanitization_runbook_20251009.csv (operation steps + operator IDs), and a signed attestation PDF once Nova signs the attestation form.

Pre-req: a single approval email from Nova (reply OK to this thread) and confirmation of any legal hold exceptions. If any hold items exist, list them explicitly.

I've attached the proposed sanitization plan for your review.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Field Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Karthik —
Thanks. Two clarifications before we say OK:
1) Confirm that ephemeral inference KV caches (redis-backed) for both prod and staging will be purged and not just tombstoned. We need proof that recovered keys won't exist.
2) For service logs, we require removal of debug-level payloads but retention of summary metrics for 365 days. Can you provide the exact log filters you'll use (e.g., levels, paths, suffixes)?

If you can confirm both, we will approve execution immediately.

— Claire

On Thu, Oct 9, 2025 at 11:30 AM Claire Rios <claire.rios@novahealth.com> wrote:
> Karthik —
> Thanks. Two clarifications before we say OK:
> 1) Confirm that ephemeral inference KV caches (redis-backed) for both prod and staging will be purged and not just tombstoned.
> 2) For service logs, we require removal of debug-level payloads but retention of summary metrics for 365 days.

Hi Claire — confirming both:
- KV caches: we will run a full purge job that issues DEL commands against the tenant-scoped key prefixes and then rekey the cache namespace. Operators will collect a before/after key count snapshot; proof is included in the manifest. The purge is destructive and irreversible for the keys in-scope.
- Logs: debug payloads will be scrubbed using the filter: level==DEBUG OR message.match(/token|prompt|response/gi) -> redact payloads; retained storage will include only summary metrics (error counts, latency p50/p95) for 365 days. We'll include the exact grep/find command and the S3 object path list in the evidence manifest.

We've received verbal clearance from NovaHealth Ops on the call; please reply OK to confirm in writing. We'll begin at 14:00 PT once we have written approval.

Execution note (ops): Marissa will run the purge and Laura will validate the evidence package; I'll coordinate the attestation delivery.

Thanks — Karthik

- Service logs: debug-level payloads removed from s3://redwood-logs/nova-cardio-2024/ with retention of summary metrics objects. Filter commands and object lists are in evidence_manifest_20251009.json.

2) Once you confirm, we will send a DocuSign attestation and attach the signed PDF back to this thread.

If you want a deeper technical walkthrough I can schedule a 30-min handoff with our infra team tomorrow.

Regards,
